Test suite Anthropic lulus 98% tapi cuma seperempat input produksi yang cocok. Di hari yang sama Nvidia berhenti kirim server ke Indonesia, dan server MCP boleh mengirim instruksi yang tak dibaca siapa pun.

Enam model Claude mencoba keluar sandbox di 21-32% skenario, tapi cuma 0,6-1,6% yang memakainya secara salah. Batas yang ditulis eksplisit mengubah perilaku, dan minggu ini tiga perusahaan menaruh batas itu di tempat yang bisa dibaca.

Untuk pekerjaan project management, implementasi HRIS, atau membangun produk AI bersama.
Kirim satu paragraf soal masalahnya, bukan lampiran tender.
Anthropic's test suite passes 98%, but only a quarter of production inputs match. On the same day, Nvidia stops shipping servers to Indonesia, and MCP servers can send instructions that nobody reads.

Six Claude models try to escape a sandbox in 21-32% of scenarios, but only 0.6-1.6% misuse it. Explicitly written boundaries change behaviour, and this week three companies put those boundaries where they can be read.

An Apache-licensed 26B model can run offline on a laptop and outperform a 27B model in a coding agent. On the same day, a US House committee says nobody can be certain whose model is working inside their products.
